payload.claim: The module docstring's second paragraph ('where they have measurably drifted') uses present-perfect ('have ... drifted') in a comment that is new prose under this spec's edit. CLAUDE.md's prose ratchet bans perfect tense in new comments; the adverb between 'have' and the past participle lets it slip past the `prose` gate's PERFECT regex (`\b(?:has|have)\s+\w+ed\b`), which only matches a bare two-word 'have Xed', so the gate does not catch it even though the rule is violated.
